provenance.scope: Selected aggregate fields copied from research-workspace output; full window inputs not bundled

visual_review.note: overlay frames plus modelV2 and odometry on three stationary-labelled windows
visual_review.B_night_queue: video label wrong: modelV2 and radar range both show the lead creeping 1-3 m/s; radar ground speed agrees in sign
visual_review.C_red_light_approach: radar range walk on a settled lead: range fell 6.4 m while ego travelled ~13.7 m, own ground speed read stopped; modelV2 closed at the odometer rate
visual_review.consequence: 30-60 m stationary results measure the video label as much as the radar; 5-30 m settled result is the usable output
